title: Duplicate MDN annotations and malformed MDN URLs for “Serializable objects”

labels.name: impacts documentation
labels.description: Used by documentation communities, such as MDN, to track changes that impact documentation

body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard? The generated MDN annotation for the **Serializable objects** section contains multiple apparently duplicate entries, and the MDN links in those entries are malformed. The affected section is: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/structured-data.html#serializable-objects The source heading is: ```html

2.7.1 Serializable objects

``` Immediately after it, the generated HTML contains an MDN annotation: ```html
``` For this particular fragment, the annotation contains multiple entries which point to the same MDN “Serializable object” page. More importantly, the generated links are malformed. They end up looking like: ```text https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Serializable_object ``` instead of: ```text https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Serializable_object ``` ### Where the data appears to come from I traced the generated annotation through the HTML build pipeline. `whatwg/html-build` downloads: ```text w3c/mdn-spec-links/html.json ``` and Wattsi uses that data to generate the `mdn-anno` blocks. For the `serializable-objects` fragment, `w3c/mdn-spec-links/html.json` currently contains several entries originating from BCD features such as: ```text javascript/builtins/Error.json javascript/builtins/EvalError.json javascript/builtins/RangeError.json javascript/builtins/ReferenceError.json javascript/builtins/SyntaxError.json javascript/builtins/TypeError.json javascript/builtins/URIError.json ``` These currently resolve to the same MDN glossary article. The corresponding upstream BCD entries contain: ```json "mdn_url": "https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Glossary/Serializable_object" ``` For example: https://github.com/mdn/browser-compat-data/blob/main/javascript/builtins/Error.json ### Malformed URL generation There also appears to be a separate issue in Wattsi. In: https://github.com/whatwg/wattsi/blob/main/src/wattsi.pas `AddMDNBox()` currently defines: ```pascal kMDNURLBase = 'https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/'; ``` and generates the link using: ```pascal kMDNURLBase + MDNSlug ``` Normally `MDNSlug` is something like: ```text API/SharedWorker ``` but in this case the generated `slug` is already a complete MDN URL: ```text https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Serializable_object ``` so the two are concatenated and produce the malformed URL. The generated data also contains an `mdn_url` field with the complete URL, so it may be safer for Wattsi to use that directly rather than reconstructing the URL from `slug`. ### Expected result The MDN annotation should: 1. not show several indistinguishable entries linking to the same MDN article; and 2. generate valid MDN URLs, including for MDN pages outside `/docs/Web/`, such as `/docs/Glossary/`.
